text: Pressurisation: control and electronic rooms and MV / LV / UPS / battery-adjacent electrical rooms shall be kept at a positive pressure of not less than 25 Pa (50 Pa for the control building and the electronic rooms) relative to the outside and to adjacent unconditioned spaces; the airflow at open doors shall be enough to keep 0.5 m/s in the door opening at the standard leakage of the building; the pressure shall be controlled by a pressure sensor per room (dual sensors on the control building) with modulating supply and relief dampers; loss of pressure shall raise an alarm in the control room.
